assets.exactPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone transparent 2.5D mobile game exterior environment sprite for a tiny popcorn factory direct-sale courtyard. Primary request: one compact complete factory shopfront facade, with pale cool mint wall panels, teal painted metal frame, a red-and-white striped fabric canopy over a broad open service window, a small plain door on the right with round window, a blank teal signboard above the canopy bearing only a simple molded popcorn cup pictogram, no lettering. The service window is empty with a clean silver counter ledge, suitable for overlaying separate character/product sprites. Style: polished friendly casual factory game 3D rendered illustration, softly beveled edges, same visual family as teal-and-steel isometric industrial machinery, not photorealistic. Composition: near-front isometric three-quarter view with right side visible, camera elevated 25 degrees, whole building unit centered and isolated with generous transparent margins. Upper-left soft studio lighting, restrained ambient occlusion. No customers, no shelves, no food props, no ground plane, no decorative scenery, no labels, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no baked checkerboard. Real transparent alpha background. Compact clear silhouette readable at 320px.
